outcome.answer: Use mixed-precision quantization to assign higher bit-widths to more important experts and lower bit-widths to less sensitive ones, which reduces memory and speeds MoE inference on constrained devices [2, 3, 5]. For mobile or edge hardware, DyMoE adds runtime importance-aware quantization, depth-adaptive scheduling, and look-ahead prefetching to cut TTFT and TPOT on commercial edge hardware [2]. If you want runtime precision control rather than fixed allocation, DPA-MoE makes routed experts any-precision by allocating prefix-decodable chunks from live router scores [7], while GEMQ and AlphaQ improve allocation with global optimization or calibration-free bit assignment [5, 3].
